# tbx

> A toolbox of small command line tools with shared runtime helpers.

## Docs

- [Tool catalog](docs/catalog.md): every tool with its alias, language and summary
- [Shared modules](docs/shared/index.md): helpers every tool reuses

## Tools

- [transcribe](tools/transcribe/README.md): Turn a video URL into a clean markdown transcript

## Shared modules

- [py/cli](docs/shared/py/cli.md): ToolContext, build_command, define_tool, load_manifest, run_tool, usage_of
- [ts/cli](docs/shared/ts/cli.md): defineTool, OptionValue, runTool, ToolContext, ToolRun, ToolUsage, usageOf, UsageOption
- [py/errors](docs/shared/py/errors.md): ExitCode, ToolError
- [ts/errors](docs/shared/ts/errors.md): ExitCode, isErrnoException, messageOf, ToolError
- [ts/gen-parser](docs/shared/ts/gen-parser.md): generateShellParser
- [ts/gen/completions](docs/shared/ts/gen/completions.md): CompletionShell, renderCompletions
- [ts/gen/contract](docs/shared/ts/gen/contract.md): CONTRACT_PLACEHOLDER, ContractCase, generateContractTests
- [ts/gen/files](docs/shared/ts/gen/files.md): compareText, GeneratedFile
- [ts/gen/index](docs/shared/ts/gen/index.md): checkDrift, generateAll, loadToolManifests, syncGenerated, undocumentedSymbols, writeGenerated
- [ts/gen/readme](docs/shared/ts/gen/readme.md): ReadmeOptions, renderCatalog, renderToolReadme
- [ts/gen/shared-docs](docs/shared/ts/gen/shared-docs.md): DOC_EXTRACT_TIMEOUT_MS, extractSharedDocs, missingSharedDocs, renderSharedDocs, SharedModuleDoc, SharedSymbol
- [ts/gen/unit](docs/shared/ts/gen/unit.md): renderSystemdTimer, renderUnit, UnitContext, UnitKind, unitLabel, UnitValidation, validateUnit, VALIDATOR_TIMEOUT_MS
- [sh/lib](docs/shared/sh/lib.md): tbx_die, tbx_error, tbx_info, tbx_result, tbx_result_json
- [ts/manifest](docs/shared/ts/manifest.md): ArgSpec, assertNoCollisions, BUILTIN_OPTIONS, describePathCollision, findPathCollisions, loadManifest, ManifestError, NAME_PATTERN, OptSpec, parseManifest, PathCollision, RESERVED_COMMANDS, ToolManifest, UnitSpec
- [py/output](docs/shared/py/output.md): Output
- [ts/output](docs/shared/ts/output.md): createOutput, Output, OutputStreams, PROCESS_STREAMS
- [ts/paths](docs/shared/ts/paths.md): binariesOnPath, EXECUTABLE_MODE, findOnPath, isWithin, PathBinary, PathEnv, PRIVATE_DIR_MODE, READABLE_MODE, tbxBinDir, xdgBaseDir
- [ts/pty](docs/shared/ts/pty.md): PtyOptions, PtyResult, runInPty
- [py/retry](docs/shared/py/retry.md): retry_policy, with_retry
- [ts/run](docs/shared/ts/run.md): CapturedOutput, captureOutput, CommandError, MAX_CAPTURE_BYTES, runBounded, runOpen, RunOptions, RunResult, signalGroup
